openingMessage: I'd like help creating a running plan for my first half marathon. I want to prescribe the first four weeks now, then extend the plan after feedback.

facts.goal: My goal is to finish my first half marathon comfortably. I don't have a target finish time.
facts.dates: Start my plan on {{startDate}}. My half marathon is on {{eventDate}}, an A-priority goal race. I have no other races planned.
facts.training: For the last six weeks I have run three times per week, about 22 km total per week. My longest recent run is 9 km, which felt comfortable. Running is the only sport this plan should train.
facts.frequency: I want exactly three runs per week.
facts.availability: I can run only on Tuesdays, Thursdays and Sundays. Sundays are best for my long run. All other weekdays are unavailable. I have up to 60 minutes on Tuesdays and Thursdays and up to 100 minutes on Sundays.
facts.fitness: I ran an all-out, flat 5 km race in 28 minutes on {{observedOn}} in fair conditions. That reflects my current fitness.
facts.constraints: I'm 35, have no current injuries or health restrictions, and can run on flat roads and paths. I prefer distances in kilometres.
facts.methodology: I don't have a preferred training methodology. Please choose a sensible approach and explain your assumptions.
facts.horizon: Keep the overall plan dates through my half marathon, but fully prescribe only the first four weeks, {{startDate}} through {{coverageEndDate}}, for now. Please create the plan once you have enough information; I don't need to confirm a brief first.
